skills.sum: Increases attack chance by 12 percentage points for each skill level.

skills.name: Hard Hit
skills.sum: Increases max damage by 2 for each skill level.

skills.name: Merchant
skills.sum: For every skill level, decreases the buying and selling gold penalty by 4 percentage points.

skills.name: Dodge
skills.sum: Increases block chance by 9 percentage points for each skill level.

skills.name: Bark Skin
skills.sum: Increases damage resistance by 1 for each skill level.

skills.name: More Criticals
skills.sum: Increases any existing critical skill given by equipment by 20 % for each skill level.

skills.name: Better Criticals
skills.sum: Increases any existing critical multiplier given by equipment by 25 % for each skill level.

skills.name: Combat Speed
skills.sum: Increases maximum action points (AP) by 1 for each skill level.

skills.name: Quick Learner
skills.sum: Increases amount of exp given by defeating monsters by 10 % for each skill level.

skills.name: Cleave
skills.sum: Gives +3 action points (AP) on every kill per skill level.

skills.name: Corpse Eater
skills.sum: Gives +1 health points (HP) on every kill per skill level.

skills.name: Increased Fortitude
skills.sum: On every subsequent level-up, maximum health points (HP) will be raised by 1 per skill level.

skills.name: Evasion
skills.sum: For every skill level, reduces both the chance of failed flee attempts by 5 % and the chance that an adjacent monster will attack by 5 %.

skills.name: Regeneration
skills.sum: Gain +1 health points (HP) on every round per skill level when no monsters are directly adjacent.

skills.name: Failure Mastery
skills.sum: For every skill level, reduces the amount of lost experience caused by death by 20 % (percentage of existing exp loss value, not percentage points).

skills.name: Magic Finder
skills.sum: Increases the chance of finding non-ordinary items by 50 % for every skill level.

skills.name: Strong Mind
skills.sum: Lowers the chance of being afflicted with mental conditions by 10 % for every skill level, up to a maximum of 70 %.

skills.name: Enduring Body
skills.sum: Lowers the chance of being afflicted with conditions affecting your physical capacity by 10 % for every skill level, up to a maximum of 70 %.

skills.name: Pure Blood
skills.sum: Lowers the chance of being afflicted with disorders of the blood by 10 % for every skill level, up to a maximum of 70 %.

skills.name: Dark blessing of the Shadow
skills.sum: Lowers the chance of being afflicted with all types of conditions by 5 %.

skills.sum: For every critical hit made, there is a 50 % chance that the hit will fracture some of the target's bones, effectively causing the 'Fracture' condition on the target.

skills.name: Rejuvenation
skills.sum: Every round (6 seconds), there is a 20 % chance that one of the active negative actor conditions will be lowered by one magnitude.

skills.name: Taunt
skills.sum: When an attacker makes an attack that misses, there is a 75 % chance that the attacker loses 2 action points (AP).

skills.sum: Increase damage resistance by 1 per skill level while having a shield or parrying weapon equipped.

skills.name: Unarmored fighting
skills.sum: While fighting without having any piece of armor equipped, gain 10 block chance per skill level.

skills.name: Light armor proficiency
skills.sum: For every skill level, increases the block chance of every piece of light armor being worn by 30 % of their original block chances.

skills.name: Heavy armor proficiency
skills.sum: For every skill level, increases the block chance of every piece of heavy armor being worn by 20 % of their original block chances.

skills.name: Fighting style: Dual wield
skills.sum: Gives benefits when fighting with two weapons at the same time, one in the main hand and one in the off-hand.

skills.name: Fighting style: Two-handed weapon
skills.sum: Gives benefits when using weapons that require both hands to wield, such as two-handed swords, greataxes or giant hammers.

skills.name: Fighting style: Weapon and shield

skills.name: Specialization: Two-handed weapon
skills.sum: Increases damage potential of two-handed weapons by an additional 50 % of the original damage potential, in addition to the benefits given by the weapon style skill.

skills.name: Specialization: Weapon and shield
skills.sum: Increases both attack chances and damage potential of weapons in the main hand.

skills.name: Spore poison immunity
skills.sum: Permanently prevents monster attacks from inflicting the "Spore poisoning" status effect.
